title: STAMP: Manufacturing-Informed Generative Design and Shape Optimization of Sheet Panels
abstract: arXiv:2611.18144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative design of formed sheet panels must preserve geometric manufacturing conditions while exploring layouts and improving performance. STAMP embeds these conditions directly in the shape representation. Each panel is described by its material layout and a reference surface with one height at each occupied position in a plane perpendicular to the drawing direction. Nominal thickness is prescribed along the normal. The representation allows curved surfaces, ribs, and openings. It excludes reference-surface undercuts and keeps nominal thickness fixed without manufacturing penalty terms. Because these conditions belong to the representation, every generated and optimized panel satisfies them regardless of training-set size. Boundary-conditioned diffusion generates alternative layouts, and predictor gradients guide a surface optimization that retains outlines, openings, and designated fixed regions. translated_title: STAMP：面向制造信息的钣金面板生成式设计与形状优化
translated_abstract: 成形钣金面板的生成式设计必须在探索布局并提升性能的同时保持几何制造条件。STAMP 将这些条件直接嵌入到形状表示中。每个面板由其材料布局以及一个参考曲面来描述，该参考曲面在与绘图方向垂直的平面上的每个被占据位置具有一个高度。名义厚度沿法线方向指定。该表示允许曲面、加强筋和开口的存在，排除了参考曲面下的倒扣，并在无需制造惩罚项的情况下保持名义厚度固定。由于这些条件属于形状表示本身，无论训练集规模如何，每个生成和优化的面板都天然满足这些制造条件。边界条件扩散模型生成备选布局，预测器梯度引导曲面优化，同时保留轮廓、开口和指定的固定区域。我们在汽车引擎盖上对 STAMP 进行了演示。
tldr: STAMP 通过将制造几何条件直接嵌入形状表示本身，实现了钣金面板的生成式设计与形状优化，使所有生成和优化的结果无论训练数据多少都能天然满足制造约束。
en_tdlr: STAMP embeds manufacturing conditions directly into the shape representation, enabling generative design and shape optimization of sheet panels where every generated and optimized result inherently satisfies manufacturing constraints regardless of training-set size.
